title.zh: WordPress回应PHP严重漏洞：建议网站运营方立即更新升级
title.en: WordPress回应PHP严重漏洞：建议网站运营方立即更新升级

current_state.zh: WordPress warned site operators to immediately update PHP and confirm hosting-provider patches and WAF mitigations because of a severe PHP vulnerability affecting servers running PHP applications.
current_state.en: WordPress warned site operators to immediately update PHP and confirm hosting-provider patches and WAF mitigations because of a severe PHP vulnerability affecting servers running PHP applications.
